evidence.source: Main paper, structural section: complex 1 is based on asymmetric monomeric unit and CCDC deposition 2453268.
Main paper, crystallographic data availability: CCDC 2453268 and 2453269 contain deposited structures for 1 and 2.
Main paper, DFT studies: neutral N and anionic N+1 geometries are optimized and fk+ is defined by atomic charges.
Main paper, experimental DFT section: B3LYP/6-311G calculations and finite-difference Fukui workflow.
Main paper, DFT section: fk+ = qk(N) − qk(N+1).
Main paper Table 4: Cu fk+ values 0.0182 (1) and 0.0299 (2).
Main paper theoretical investigation: Cu fk+ in 2 is substantially higher and binding interaction is described as stronger.
Main paper abstract: complexes oxidize 3,5-DTBC to 3,5-DTBQ and complex 2 has higher catecholase activity.
